panel.name: panel_performance_timings
panel.string: Capture measures for the seconds set on the left (after a 1 s warm-up) and copies a plain-text summary to the clipboard. It has hardware, settings and timings only: no names, places or positions. Paste it into a report, or use Report a problem.
Capturing... [SECONDS] s left. Keep the view where the problem happens.
Last capture ([MINUTES] min ago): [SUMMARY]. Saved as [FILE] (a capture started here is also on the clipboard; Copy puts it there again).
panel.text: Where each frame's time goes on this computer. Measured only while this page is open or a capture runs.

spinner.label: Seconds
spinner.name: capture_seconds
spinner.tool_tip: How long a capture measures (3-60 s).

button.label: Capture
button.name: capture_btn
button.tool_tip: Measure for that many seconds, then copy a plain-text summary to the clipboard and save it in the logs folder.

button.label: Copy
button.name: copy_capture_btn
button.tool_tip: Copy the last capture to the clipboard again.

button.label: Report a problem...
button.name: report_btn
button.tool_tip: Help > Report Bug. Tick "Performance problem" there to attach the last capture.
